name: LunaTV
description: 本项目采用 CC BY-NC-SA 协议，禁止任何商业化行为，任何衍生项目必须保留本项目地址并以相同协议开源
one_liner: A self-hosted app that lets you search and stream movies/TV shows pulled together from multiple free video sources, with your watch history synced across devices — you have to supply your own video sources.
buyer: No legitimate commercial buyer — the project's own license explicitly bans any commercial use, and it ships as an empty shell requiring the user to plug in their own (often unlicensed) video sources.
business_use_cases: N/A — the license (CC BY-NC-SA) explicitly forbids commercialization of this project or derivatives.
N/A — the core function depends on third-party video sources of unclear licensing, which is a legal risk for any business use.
The only legitimate takeaway is technical: a hobbyist could self-host it purely for personal, non-commercial use, which the license does allow.

money_ideas.idea: None that respect the license or copyright law — building a paid product on top of this specific project is explicitly prohibited and the underlying content-sourcing model raises separate piracy concerns.

steal_this: Nothing to build commercially here — this is a personal-use media aggregator whose license and content model rule out a business. If the underlying idea (personal cross-device watch-history sync) interests you, build it against sources you actually license.
